degree_rationale: The phthonos (envy) of Hyle — the first nature in the dark cosmos, who envied the First Man's garments, the Ambassador's icon, Adam, the saints; whose evil casts itself out and the New Man drives away from herself. Treats the natural workings of envy as cosmic source of begetting.
direction_rationale: The originating natural force of envy — generative of darkness's begetting in the cosmos. Foundation of the natural-evil dynamic.
grand_man_function: Natural envy-source — the originating dark counter-begetting.
title: The Phthonos (envy) of Hyle and how she molded after light's image
